name: SSL Certificate Decoder
summary: Decode PEM X.509 certificates locally — subject, issuer, validity, and fingerprint.
description: Paste a PEM certificate block to inspect subject and issuer DN fields, validity dates, serial number, and SHA-256 fingerprint without uploading to a server.

faqs.question: Is my certificate uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. PEM text is parsed and hashed locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I paste a certificate chain?
faqs.answer: Multiple PEM blocks in one paste are decoded separately.
